test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution 

Whether she wishes to relocate to Mumbai or continues to live here __are her personal decisions__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is discussing two options regarding her decision.
 
• The correct form should maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• The singular form "is her personal decision" correctly matches the subject and verb, ensuring the sentence is grammatically accurate.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the original segment of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Whether she wishes to relocate to Mumbai or continues to live here is her personal decision."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "were her personal decisions," **– Incorrect as it does not match the singular subject.
 
• **Option 2: "No substitution required," **– Incorrect as the original segment has an error.
 
• **Option 4: "have her personal decision," **– Incorrect as it does not maintain subject-verb agreement.
